title: Trinetra Ganesh Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Trinetra Ganesh ji ko pehla card kyun?

scenes.prompt: Close-up of a vermilion-orange swayambhu Lord Ganesh murti with three eyes, the third eye on the forehead, elephant face, large ears, tilak, marigold garland, brass diyas glowing in front, inside a stone fort temple, front-facing, serene
scenes.tts: त्रिनेत्र गणेश जी, रणथंभौर! पहला न्योता इन्हीं को क्यों जाता है?
scenes.sub: Trinetra Ganesh ji, Ranthambore! Pehla nyota inhi ko kyun jaata hai?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, a few marigold petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: Ancient Ranthambore fort on a rocky hill in Rajasthan at golden sunrise, sandstone ramparts and gateways, a stone path climbing up to the Ganesh temple
scenes.tts: यह मंदिर राजस्थान के सवाई माधोपुर में, रणथंभौर किले के भीतर है।
scenes.sub: Yeh mandir Rajasthan ke Sawai Madhopur mein, Ranthambore qile ke andar hai.

scenes.prompt: Lord Ganesh with three eyes seated with Riddhi and Siddhi, and his two sons Shubh and Labh beside him, orange-vermilion murtis in a stone temple, marigold garlands, warm diya light, close-up, serene
scenes.tts: तीसरी आँख वाले गणेश जी, साथ में रिद्धि-सिद्धि और शुभ-लाभ।
scenes.sub: Teesri aankh wale Ganesh ji, saath mein Riddhi-Siddhi aur Shubh-Labh.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the faces stay still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, incense smoke rises slowly

scenes.prompt: A family hands a red wedding invitation card with a ribbon to a temple priest in front of a Ganesh temple inside an old fort, warm morning light, marigold garlands
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, राजा हम्मीर को सपना आया। शादी का पहला कार्ड यहीं भेजते हैं।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, Raja Hammir ko sapna aaya. Shaadi ka pehla card yahin bhejte hain.

scenes.tts: ॐ गं गणपतये नमः। पसंद आए तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय त्रिनेत्र गणेश!
scenes.sub: Om Gam Ganapataye Namah. Pasand aaye to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Trinetra Ganesh!
